summary: First Merchants Corporation filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated September 23, 2026 with Piper Sandler & Co. as representative of the underwriters, covering the sale of $100 million aggregate principal amount of 6.750% fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes due 2036. The notes were offered under an effective Form S-3 shelf registration. A same-day press release announced pricing. This is a routine investment-grade-style bank subordinated debt takedown, not a special situation. No equity terms, premium, board recommendation, or deal protections are stated. Watch regulatory capital treatment and spread to peers.
